status: Production plan only; all production entries are pending. Existing source atlases are verified separately in reuse-audit.md.

sourcePolicy.preferred: Reference-guided generation, original typography and controlled layer compositing.
sourcePolicy.fallback: If hero foliage cannot achieve reference material quality, evaluate licensed/CC0 mature plant geometry for offline render. No purchase/download is implied or authorized by this plan.
sourcePolicy.editableSources: source-art/rebuild/ remains outside public distribution. Preserve original generator output, edited master and export separately.
sourcePolicy.generatedProvenance: Record actual image tool, prompt/edit sequence, date and source reference when produced. This plan does not invent production provenance.
sourcePolicy.licenses: Existing fonts retain OFL files. Existing AI concept atlases retain manifest source records. Do not treat supplier preview images as freely licensed assets.

exportPolicy.master: Lossless PNG or layered project; transparent items straight alpha
exportPolicy.runtime: WebP or AVIF chosen after visual comparison; retain compatible WebP fallback where needed
exportPolicy.alphaInspection: Composite on cream, dark gray and checkerboard; inspect hair, twine and leaves at 100–200%. No white fringe or duplicate shadow.
exportPolicy.maxUpscale: No atlas enlargement for featured foreground; close-up originals are separately generated.
exportPolicy.bytes: Every bytes:null is pending production measurement, not zero.
exportPolicy.versioning: approvedVersion is null until visual approval. Source and bridge reference one approved version.
exportPolicy.budget: Initial critical asset target approximately 3 MB compressed; measure after production. Defer gallery/background atlases and never silently remove required people/works to meet target.
